verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no reporting or dashboard feature covering pipeline, activity, or conversion metrics. Saved filtered and grouped views (docs-16) and a vague claim that customizable pipelines give 'valuable insights' (docs-21) are adjacent list or pipeline features, not report or dashboard building, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet
